messages.content:
Rewrite these unverified audio-model observations into non-speech captions
for Deaf/hard-of-hearing viewers. These observations are the ONLY factual input;
do not add sounds, source identities, emotion, visuals, plot or interpretations.
Do not treat observations as independently verified. Remove speculative causes
or moods. Preserve multiple audible sound types. Three texts per observation:
essential (short labels), balanced (brief description), detailed (more of the
already supplied acoustic detail, at most 25 words). All <= 278 characters, no
brackets, markup or newlines. If the observation explicitly reports no non-speech
sounds, return null texts for that id. Return only a JSON object with key captions,
an array of objects with EXACT keys id, essential, balanced, detailed. Preserve
every input id exactly once. Do not generate timestamps. Observations:
[{"id": "360", "observation": "A dramatic orchestral piece featuring sweeping strings, powerful brass, and resonant percussion creates a tense, cinematic atmosphere."}, {"id": "390", "observation": "A loud, high-pitched scream is followed by a deep, resonant roar and a sustained, low-frequency musical drone."}, {"id": "405", "observation": "A dramatic orchestral score with sweeping strings and powerful percussion plays, accompanied by a deep, resonant rumble."}, {"id": "420", "observation": "A loud, sustained electronic tone with a descending pitch and a brief, high-pitched squeal are audible."}, {"id": "435", "observation": "A sharp metallic impact is followed by a sustained high-pitched electronic tone and intermittent rustling sounds."}, {"id": "450", "observation": "The non-speech sounds include footsteps and a door opening and closing."}, {"id": "465", "observation": "A clock ticks steadily, followed by a brief musical passage and a distinct mechanical click."}, {"id": "480", "observation": "A person is walking on a hard surface, with footsteps and rustling sounds, accompanied by a continuous electronic beep."}]
